content: वर्तन {%a.%} [वृत्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] .²1 Abiding, living, staying, being <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Stationary. .{@-नः@} A dwarf. .{@-नी@} .²1 A road, way. .²2 Living, life. .²3 Pounding, grinding. .²4 Sending off, despatching. .²5 A spindle. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Living, being. .²2 Staying, abiding, residing. .²3 Action, movement, mode or manner of living; स्मरसि च तदुपान्तेष्वावयोर्वर्तनानि <ls>U. 1. 26</ls>; (the word may here mean ‘abode or residence’, also). .²4 Living on, subsisting (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>). .²5 Livelihood, maintenance, subsistence; तैरेवास्य कलेः कलेवरपुषो दैनंदिनं वर्तनम् <ls>Bv. 1. 103</ls>. .²6 Turning round, revolving. .²7 Rolling on, moving about. .²8 Appointing. .²9 A means of subsistence, profession, occupation. .²10 Conduct, behaviour, proceeding. .²11 Wages, salary, hire. .²12 Commerce, traffic. .²13 A spindle. .²14 A globe, ball. .²15 Application of; colouring; निहितमलक्तवर्तनाभिताम्रम् <ls>Ki. 10. 42</ls>. .²16 An often-told word. .²17 Decoction.
